title: What is an AI demo agent? How it works, the types and how to choose
summary: An AI demo agent gives buyers a live product demo the moment they ask. How it works, the 4 types, 11 vendors compared, a 10-point test and public prices.
body_markdown:
Karumi is an AI demo agent, so this guide comes from what we see in buyer conversations every day. It covers the definition, the four types on the market, Karumi and ten other vendors side by side, how an AI demo agent works, what to test before you buy and the prices that are public.


## What is an AI demo agent?


An AI demo agent does the first demo that a sales engineer used to do. It has four jobs:


- **Talk.** It holds a two-way conversation by voice or chat, in the buyer's language.
- **Show.** It puts the product on screen: the real product in a live browser, a copy of it, or captured screens, depending on the vendor.
- **Answer.** It answers from your docs and your rules, and says so when it does not know.
- **Hand off.** It qualifies the buyer, offers a meeting and sends a summary to your CRM.


The demos an AI demo agent runs are also called **agentic demos** . See[what agentic demos are and how they work](https://karumi.ai/blog/agentic-demos) .


An AI demo agent is different from a chatbot, a guided tour (some vendors call it an interactive demo) or a demo video, although it borrows from all three. See[what an inbound agent is](https://karumi.ai/blog/what-is-an-inbound-agent) and[agentic demos vs interactive demos](https://karumi.ai/blog/agentic-demos-vs.-interactive-demos) .

Buyers meet an AI demo agent in three places: a **demo link** in an email, an ad or an outbound sequence; a **widget or chat bar** on your website; and **inside a video call** , where some AI demo agents[join Google Meet, Zoom or Teams](https://karumi.ai/blog/can-karumi-join-google-meet-zoom-teams-calls) next to your rep.


## What types of AI demo agents are there?


Vendors came to this category from different starting points, so one name covers four different products. The useful question is what the buyer sees on screen. Many vendors sell more than one type. See[is a Karumi demo live or a recording?](https://karumi.ai/blog/is-karumi-demo-live-or-recording)


Type What the buyer sees Good at Weak at Best for


Guided tour with an AI layer Captured screens with chat or voice on top Fast to build, stable Answers stop where the capture stops Simple products, marketing pages


Presenter or avatar A face or voice that presents slides, video or screens A human feel on the page Can be more watch than explore Brand-led, early-stage pages


Replica or sandbox A working copy of the product with sample data Safe data, stable flows The copy can drift from the real product Products with sensitive data


Live product The real product in a live browser, signed in to a demo account Shows anything the product does Logins, bot checks and UI changes to handle Complex B2B products, many personas

## How does an AI demo agent work?


The buyer clicks a link or a button, and a call opens with the AI demo agent next to the product. It asks what the buyer wants to see, shows it in the product and answers questions as they come. The buyer can interrupt at any time.


A Karumi demo on karumi.ai: the AI demo agent on the right, the product on the left. Karumi's Questions & Answers view: every question buyers asked, grouped by topic.


Under the hood, most AI demo agents run the same six steps. Vendors differ in how each step holds up when a real buyer asks something unexpected.


Step What happens What can go wrong How to check


1. Learn the product It learns from your docs and by exploring the product itself Invented features when its knowledge has gaps Ask about a feature you do not have


2. Open the demo The buyer clicks a link, a widget or a chat bar, or the agent joins a call A slow start, or a form before anything happens Time it from click to first word


3. Discover It asks for the buyer's role and goal, and can look up the company A long interview before any product Count the questions before the first screen


4. Show It shows the product and explains each screen Login walls, bot checks, a changed UI, slow pages Rename a button in your product and run it again


5. Answer It answers from your docs and rules Long pauses, invented answers, real customer data on screen Ask a pricing, a security and an off-topic question


6. Hand off It offers a meeting or trial and updates your CRM Empty CRM notes, the wrong rep, no follow-up Read the CRM record after a test session


See[how Karumi learns your product](https://karumi.ai/blog/how-does-karumi-learn-my-product) (step 1) and[what Karumi sends to HubSpot after a demo](https://karumi.ai/blog/what-does-karumi-send-to-hubspot) (step 6). All CRM and calendar connections are on the[integrations page](https://karumi.ai/integrations) .


### What goes wrong most often?


- **Latency.** In a voice call, a pause of more than a second or two feels broken. Time a few answers yourself.
- **Invented answers.** A good AI demo agent says it does not know and offers to ask your team.
- **Login walls and bot checks.** An AI demo agent that uses the real product must get past single sign-on, two-factor codes and bot protection on every session.
- **Demo data.** A buyer must never see a real customer's record. Ask where the demo data comes from and how it resets.
- **Product changes.** Every release can move a button. Ask how the vendor finds a broken flow before a buyer does.


We cover the engineering side in[should you build your own AI demo agent?](https://karumi.ai/blog/build-vs-buy-ai-demo-agent)


## What do buyers ask an AI demo agent?


In our experience, buyers ask the same kinds of questions everywhere:


- **"Can it do this?"** Most questions are about what the product can do, and buyers want to see the answer on screen.
- **Pricing and next steps.** How much it costs, whether there is a trial and how to start. Decide what the AI demo agent may say about price before you launch.
- **Integrations and setup.** Which tools it connects to and how long it takes to go live.
- **Security and comparisons.** These come up less often, but they matter most to the deal. Give the AI demo agent clear, approved answers.


## How do you test an AI demo agent before you buy?


Run every vendor through the same ten tests, on your own product, with your own questions. Score each line 0 (fails), 1 (partly) or 2 (passes), then compare the totals out of 20.


# Test How to run it Passes when


1 Real product Ask for something nobody prepared It shows it in your product, or a faithful copy


2 Unexpected question Ask about a niche feature It answers correctly, or says it does not know


3 Interruption Say "wait, go back" in the middle of a sentence It stops, goes back and continues


4 Speed Time five answers No silence feels longer than a person's reply


5 Pricing Ask "how much does it cost?" It follows your pricing policy every time


6 Objection Say "we already use another tool" It answers the point, without attacking anyone


7 Language Start in another language, then switch It follows the buyer


8 Off hours Start a session late on a Sunday Same quality, and booking still works


9 Hand-off Ask for a meeting, then open your CRM The record shows the questions, answers and next step


10 Product change Change a label in your product and run it again The demo still works, or the vendor finds the break first


Also ask for the SOC 2 and ISO 27001 reports, where transcripts are stored, and which AI model providers see them.

## FAQ


### What is an AI demo agent in simple terms?


It is software that gives a buyer a product demo on demand. It talks, shows the product on screen, answers questions and offers the next step, such as a meeting.


### Is an AI demo agent the same as a chatbot?


No. A chatbot answers in a text window. An AI demo agent shows the product while it answers, by voice or chat, and qualifies the buyer for your sales team.


### Is an AI demo agent the same as an interactive demo?


No. An interactive demo is a guided tour of captured screens that the buyer clicks through. An AI demo agent talks with the buyer and shows the product live, so it can answer questions nobody prepared for.


### Does an AI demo agent use my real product?


It depends on the vendor. Some use the real product in a live browser, some use a copy with sample data, and some use captured screens. Karumi can run your real product or a replica, and you choose.


### Can an AI demo agent join a Zoom, Google Meet or Teams call?


Some can. Karumi joins Google Meet, Zoom, Teams, Webex and other call platforms, and 1mind says it joins Zoom calls. See[can Karumi join a Google Meet, Zoom or Teams call?](https://karumi.ai/blog/can-karumi-join-google-meet-zoom-teams-calls)


### Which languages can an AI demo agent speak?


Vendors state from about 20 to more than 80. Karumi speaks 70+ languages, with regional variants for accents. See[which languages Karumi speaks](https://karumi.ai/blog/which-languages-does-karumi-support) .


### What happens when the AI demo agent does not know the answer?


A good AI demo agent says so and offers to pass the question to your team, instead of guessing.


### How long does it take to set up an AI demo agent?


Most teams are live with Karumi in about two weeks, per our[build vs buy guide](https://karumi.ai/blog/build-vs-buy-ai-demo-agent) . Building your own takes months.


### How much does an AI demo agent cost?


Published prices start at $99 in credits (Supademo) and $249 a month billed yearly (Naoma). Most vendors, Karumi included, give a price after a call.
